description: This file contains utility functions and constants for creating user data objects, including resetting user properties and generating new user input data, with dependencies on crypto and nanoid libraries.

methods.name: createResetProperties
methods.description: Generates default reset data for user properties, including challenge completion status, certifications, and progress timestamps.

methods.name: createUserInput
methods.description: Creates default input data for a new user, including unique username and external ID, profile settings, and initial properties.
